headline: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 2.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon)
text: Last night: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 2.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon); magnetometer Kilpisjärvi -101 nT at 00:31; Tromsø clear 01–03, 04–08, Alta cloudy
